description: Change text case (upper, lower, title, sentence, camel, pascal, snake, kebab, constant), turn each line into a URL slug, or remove duplicate lines while keeping the original order.

ignore_case.description: For dedupe: treat Apple and apple as the same line.

input.description: Path to a file to read instead of text.

output.description: Save the result to this file instead of returning it.

overwrite.description: Replace the output file if it already exists. Defaults to false.

remove_empty.description: For dedupe: also drop empty lines.

text.description: The text itself. Use this or input.

trim.description: For dedupe: ignore spaces at the start and end of lines when comparing. Defaults to true.

name: text_transform
title: Transform text
